svg.aria-label: An isometric late-1990s desk computer: a beige CRT monitor on a swivel base showing a browser window with the Google mark and a search box, a mid-tower case with CD-ROM, floppy drive, Intel and Windows 98 badges and a floppy disk on top, a 104-key keyboard, a ball mouse on a purple pad, a stereo speaker, a CD-R in its jewel case and a floppy disk on the floor, joined by cables.
